datasets.name: orq_ultima_run
queryLines:
SELECT
  job_name AS Pipeline,
  DATE_FORMAT(from_utc_timestamp(period_end_time, 'America/Sao_Paulo'), 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') AS `Concluído em`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      DATEDIFF(SECOND, period_start_time, period_end_time) >= 60
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        FLOOR(DATEDIFF(SECOND, period_start_time, period_end_time) / 60),
        'min ',
        ROUND(DATEDIFF(SECOND, period_start_time, period_end_time) % 60),
        's'
      )
    ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(DATEDIFF(SECOND, period_start_time, period_end_time)), ' seg')
  END AS `Tempo de Execução`,
  CASE
    WHEN result_state = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN '✅ Sucesso'
    WHEN result_state = 'FAILED' THEN '❌ Falhou'
    WHEN result_state = 'CANCELLED' THEN '⚠️ Cancelado'
    WHEN result_state = 'ERROR' THEN '❌ Erro'
    ELSE result_state
  END AS Resultado
FROM
  workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_runs
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(period_end_time, ingested_at) DESC
LIMIT 1

datasets.name: orq_media_5runs
queryLines:
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(SECOND, period_start_time, period_end_time)) / 60.0, 1) AS duracao_minutos
FROM
  workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_runs
WHERE
  COALESCE(period_end_time, ingested_at) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
  AND period_start_time IS NOT NULL
  AND period_end_time IS NOT NULL
  AND (:ambiente IS NULL OR array_contains(:ambiente, INITCAP(ambiente)))
  AND (:tipo_execucao IS NULL OR array_contains(:tipo_execucao, CASE WHEN LOWER(trigger_type) = 'cron' THEN 'Automático' WHEN LOWER(trigger_type) = 'onetime' THEN 'Manual' ELSE trigger_type END))

datasets.name: orq_taxa_sucesso
queryLines:
SELECT

      CASE

        ELSE 0
      END
    )
      * 100.0
      / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    1
  ) AS taxa_sucesso_pct
FROM
  workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_runs
WHERE
  COALESCE(period_end_time, ingested_at) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
  AND (:ambiente IS NULL OR array_contains(:ambiente, INITCAP(ambiente)))
  AND (:tipo_execucao IS NULL OR array_contains(:tipo_execucao, CASE WHEN LOWER(trigger_type) = 'cron' THEN 'Automático' WHEN LOWER(trigger_type) = 'onetime' THEN 'Manual' ELSE trigger_type END))

datasets.name: orq_task_breakdown
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN task_key = 'check_landing_zone' THEN 'Verificação Landing Zone'
    WHEN task_key = 'bronze_bpa' THEN 'Bronze - BPA'
    WHEN task_key = 'bronze_bpp' THEN 'Bronze - BPP'
    WHEN task_key = 'bronze_dre' THEN 'Bronze - DRE'
    WHEN task_key = 'silver_bpa' THEN 'Silver - BPA'
    WHEN task_key = 'silver_bpp' THEN 'Silver - BPP'
    WHEN task_key = 'silver_dre' THEN 'Silver - DRE'
    WHEN task_key = 'verificacao_landing' THEN 'Verificação Diária'
    WHEN task_key = 'ddl_create_tables' THEN 'Preparação de Tabelas'
    WHEN task_key = 'transposicao_system' THEN 'Transposição Sistema'
    ELSE task_key
  END AS Etapa,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(duracao_segundos, task_duracao_segundos)) / 60.0, 1) AS duracao_minutos,
  'Pipeline Completo' AS barra
FROM
  workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.base_unificada
WHERE
  COALESCE(period_end_time, execucao_created_at) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
  AND COALESCE(duracao_segundos, task_duracao_segundos) IS NOT NULL
  AND task_key IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    :ambiente IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:ambiente, INITCAP(ambiente))
  )
  AND (
    :tipo_execucao IS NULL
    OR array_contains(
      :tipo_execucao,
      CASE
        WHEN LOWER(trigger_type) = 'cron' THEN 'Automático'
        WHEN LOWER(trigger_type) = 'onetime' THEN 'Manual'
        ELSE trigger_type
      END
    )
  )
GROUP BY
  task_key
ORDER BY
  duracao_minutos DESC

datasets.name: exe_cobertura
queryLines:
SELECT
  fonte,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        ano = 2021
      THEN
        CASE task_result_state
          WHEN 'SUCCEEDED' THEN '✅'
          WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'ERROR' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '⚠️'
          ELSE '—'
        END
    END
  ) AS `2021`,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        ano = 2022
      THEN
        CASE task_result_state
          WHEN 'SUCCEEDED' THEN '✅'
          WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'ERROR' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '⚠️'
          ELSE '—'
        END
    END
  ) AS `2022`,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        ano = 2023
      THEN
        CASE task_result_state
          WHEN 'SUCCEEDED' THEN '✅'
          WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'ERROR' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '⚠️'
          ELSE '—'
        END
    END
  ) AS `2023`,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        ano = 2024
      THEN
        CASE task_result_state
          WHEN 'SUCCEEDED' THEN '✅'
          WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'ERROR' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '⚠️'
          ELSE '—'
        END
    END
  ) AS `2024`,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        ano = 2025
      THEN
        CASE task_result_state
          WHEN 'SUCCEEDED' THEN '✅'
          WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'ERROR' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '⚠️'
          ELSE '—'
        END
    END
  ) AS `2025`,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        ano = 2026
      THEN
        CASE task_result_state
          WHEN 'SUCCEEDED' THEN '✅'
          WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'ERROR' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '⚠️'
          ELSE '—'
        END
    END
  ) AS `2026`
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      fonte,
      ano,
      task_result_state,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fonte, ano ORDER BY period_end_time DESC) AS rn
    FROM
      workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.base_unificada
    WHERE
      fonte IS NOT NULL
      AND ano IS NOT NULL
  ) sub
WHERE
  rn = 1
GROUP BY
  fonte
ORDER BY
  fonte

datasets.name: orq_status_hero
queryLines:
WITH falha_recente AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM
    workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_runs
  WHERE
    result_state != 'SUCCEEDED'
    AND period_end_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
),
semanal_executou AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM
    workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_runs
  WHERE
    job_name LIKE '%CVM - Pipeline Completo Semanal'
    AND result_state = 'SUCCEEDED'
    AND period_end_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 8 DAYS
),
diario_executou AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM
    workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_runs
  WHERE
    job_name LIKE '%CVM - Verificação Diária Landing Zone'
    AND result_state = 'SUCCEEDED'
    AND period_end_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 26 HOURS
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN
      (
        SELECT
          total
        FROM
          falha_recente
      ) > 0
    THEN
      'ALERTA — falha em run recente'
    WHEN
      (
        SELECT
          total
        FROM
          semanal_executou
      ) = 0
    THEN
      'ALERTA — pipeline semanal atrasado'
    WHEN
      (
        SELECT
          total
        FROM
          diario_executou
      ) = 0
    THEN
      'ALERTA — verificação diária atrasada'
    ELSE '✓ SAUDÁVEL'
  END AS status_pipeline

datasets.name: exe_heatmap_throughput
queryLines:
WITH ultima_run AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    MAX(period_end_time) AS max_fim_ts
  FROM
    workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.base_unificada
  WHERE
    run_id IS NOT NULL
    AND registros_processados IS NOT NULL
    AND registros_processados > 0
    AND duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
    AND duracao_segundos > 0
    AND period_end_time IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    run_id
  ORDER BY
    max_fim_ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  fonte,
  etapa,
  ROUND(
    SUM(registros_processados) / NULLIF(SUM(duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 0),
    1
  ) AS throughput_reg_min,
  SUM(registros_processados) AS total_registros,
  ROUND(SUM(duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 1) AS total_duracao_min
FROM
  workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.base_unificada
WHERE
  run_id
    = (
      SELECT
        run_id
      FROM
        ultima_run
    )
  AND fonte IS NOT NULL
  AND etapa IN ('bronze', 'silver')
  AND registros_processados IS NOT NULL
  AND duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  fonte,
  etapa
ORDER BY
  fonte,
  etapa

datasets.name: exe_kpis_contexto
queryLines:
WITH ultima_run AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    MAX(period_end_time) AS max_fim_ts
  FROM
    workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.base_unificada
  WHERE
    run_id IS NOT NULL
    AND registros_processados IS NOT NULL
    AND registros_processados > 0
    AND duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
    AND duracao_segundos > 0
    AND period_end_time IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    run_id
  ORDER BY
    max_fim_ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
kpis_ultima AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(registros_processados) AS volume_total,
    ROUND(SUM(duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 1) AS duracao_total_min,
    ROUND(
      SUM(registros_processados) / NULLIF(SUM(duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 0),
      0
    ) AS throughput_reg_min,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id_execucao) AS total_execucoes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN registros_processados > 0 THEN id_execucao END) AS execucoes_completas
  FROM
    workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.base_unificada
  WHERE
    run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM ultima_run)
    AND registros_processados IS NOT NULL
    AND duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
),
kpis_48h AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(volume_total) AS media_volume_48h,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duracao_total_min) AS p10_duracao,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duracao_total_min) AS p50_duracao,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duracao_total_min) AS p90_duracao,
    AVG(throughput_reg_min) AS media_throughput_48h
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        run_id,
        SUM(registros_processados) AS volume_total,
        ROUND(SUM(duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 1) AS duracao_total_min,
        ROUND(
          SUM(registros_processados) / NULLIF(SUM(duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 0),
          0
        ) AS throughput_reg_min
      FROM
        workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.base_unificada
      WHERE
        period_end_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
        AND registros_processados IS NOT NULL
        AND registros_processados > 0
        AND duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
        AND duracao_segundos > 0
      GROUP BY
        run_id
    ) sub
)
SELECT
  k.volume_total,
  k.duracao_total_min,
  k.throughput_reg_min,
  k.total_execucoes,
  k.execucoes_completas,
  ROUND(
    ((k.volume_total - m.media_volume_48h) / NULLIF(m.media_volume_48h, 0)) * 100.0,
    0
  ) AS variacao_volume_pct,
  ROUND(m.media_volume_48h, 0) AS baseline_volume,
  ROUND(
    ((k.throughput_reg_min - m.media_throughput_48h) / NULLIF(m.media_throughput_48h, 0)) * 100.0,
    0
  ) AS variacao_throughput_pct,
  ROUND(m.media_throughput_48h, 0) AS baseline_throughput,
  100000 AS alvo_throughput,
  ROUND(m.p10_duracao, 1) AS p10_duracao,
  ROUND(m.p50_duracao, 1) AS p50_duracao,
  ROUND(m.p90_duracao, 1) AS p90_duracao
FROM
  kpis_ultima k
    CROSS JOIN kpis_48h m

queryLines:

baselines AS (

        fonte,
        etapa,
        run_id,
        ROUND(
          SUM(registros_processados) / NULLIF(SUM(duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 0),
          0
        ) AS throughput_run
      FROM
        workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.base_unificada
      WHERE
        period_end_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
        AND fonte IS NOT NULL
        AND etapa IN ('bronze', 'silver')
        AND registros_processados IS NOT NULL
        AND registros_processados > 0
        AND duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
        AND duracao_segundos > 0
      GROUP BY
        fonte,
        etapa,
        run_id
    ) sub
  GROUP BY
    fonte,
    etapa
),
analise AS (
  SELECT
    m.fonte,
    m.etapa,
    m.throughput_atual,
    b.throughput_baseline,
    ROUND(
      ((m.throughput_atual - b.throughput_baseline) / NULLIF(b.throughput_baseline, 0)) * 100.0,
      0
    ) AS variacao_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN m.throughput_atual < b.throughput_baseline * 0.7 THEN 'CRITICO'
      WHEN m.throughput_atual < b.throughput_baseline * 0.85 THEN 'ATENCAO'
      ELSE 'OK'
    END AS status
  FROM
    metricas_ultima m
      INNER JOIN baselines b
        ON m.fonte = b.fonte
        AND m.etapa = b.etapa
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(fonte, ' / ', etapa) AS fonte_etapa,
  throughput_atual,
  throughput_baseline,
  variacao_pct,
  status,
  CASE
    WHEN
      status = 'CRITICO'
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'CRÍTICO: ',
        fonte,
        ' ',
        etapa,
        ' com throughput ',
        ABS(variacao_pct),
        '% abaixo da baseline — investigar urgente'
      )
    WHEN
      status = 'ATENCAO'
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'ATENÇÃO: ',
        fonte,
        ' ',
        etapa,
        ' com throughput ',
        ABS(variacao_pct),
        '% abaixo da baseline — monitorar'
      )
    ELSE CONCAT(fonte, ' ', etapa, ' dentro do esperado (', variacao_pct, '% vs baseline)')
  END AS mensagem
FROM
  analise
ORDER BY
  CASE status
    WHEN 'CRITICO' THEN 1
    WHEN 'ATENCAO' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  variacao_pct

queryLines:
SELECT

datasets.name: exe_kpis_periodo
queryLines:
WITH pipeline_execs AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    id_execucao,
    registros_processados,
    duracao_segundos,
    from_utc_timestamp(fim_ts, 'America/Sao_Paulo') AS fim_local,
    CAST(date_trunc('week', from_utc_timestamp(fim_ts, 'America/Sao_Paulo')) AS DATE) AS semana
  FROM
    workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_execucoes
  WHERE
    etapa IN ('bronze', 'silver')
    AND run_id IS NOT NULL
    AND fim_ts IS NOT NULL
    AND registros_processados IS NOT NULL
    AND registros_processados > 0
    AND duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
    AND duracao_segundos > 0
),
run_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    MAX(semana) AS semana,
    MAX(fim_local) AS run_period,
    SUM(registros_processados) AS volume_total,
    ROUND(SUM(duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 1) AS duracao_total_min,
    ROUND(
      SUM(registros_processados) / NULLIF(SUM(duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 0),
      0
    ) AS throughput_reg_min
  FROM
    pipeline_execs
  GROUP BY
    run_id
),
week_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    semana,
    COUNT(*) AS runs_na_semana,
    AVG(volume_total) AS sem_volume,
    AVG(duracao_total_min) AS sem_duracao,
    AVG(throughput_reg_min) AS sem_throughput
  FROM
    run_metrics
  GROUP BY
    semana
),
baselines AS (
  SELECT
    r.run_id,
    ROUND(AVG(w.sem_volume), 0) AS baseline_volume,
    ROUND(AVG(w.sem_throughput), 0) AS baseline_throughput,
    ROUND(AVG(w.sem_duracao), 1) AS baseline_duracao,
    ROUND(AVG(w.runs_na_semana), 0) AS baseline_runs,
    COUNT(w.semana) AS semanas_baseline,
    SUM(w.runs_na_semana) + 1 AS total_runs_analise
  FROM
    run_metrics r
      JOIN week_metrics w
        ON w.semana >= DATE_SUB(r.semana, 28)
        AND w.semana < r.semana
  GROUP BY
    r.run_id
)
SELECT
  r.run_period,
  r.volume_total,
  r.duracao_total_min,
  r.throughput_reg_min,
  w.runs_na_semana,
  b.baseline_volume,
  b.baseline_throughput,
  b.baseline_duracao,
  b.baseline_runs,
  b.semanas_baseline,
  b.total_runs_analise
FROM
  run_metrics r
    JOIN week_metrics w
      ON w.semana = r.semana
    LEFT JOIN baselines b
      ON b.run_id = r.run_id
ORDER BY
  r.run_period DESC

datasets.name: ing_resumo_ingestao
queryLines:
SELECT
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN ingest_ts
    END
  ) AS ultima_ingestao,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN last_modified_cvm
    END
  ) AS ultima_versao_cvm,
  DATEDIFF(
    CAST(
      MAX(
        CASE
          WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN ingest_ts
        END
      ) AS DATE
    ),
    CAST(
      MAX(
        CASE
          WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN last_modified_cvm
        END
      ) AS DATE
    )
  ) AS dias_publicacao_ate_ingestao,
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN ano
    END
  ) AS anos_cobertos
FROM
  proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.controle_ingestao
WHERE
  fonte NOT IN ('landing_verificacao')

datasets.name: ing_volume_tempo
datasets.displayName: Volume Baixado ao Longo do Tempo
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE(ingest_ts) AS data_verificacao,
  ROUND(SUM(bytes_arquivo) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 1) AS mb_baixados
FROM
  proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.controle_ingestao
WHERE
  fonte = 'landing_verificacao'
  AND status = 'SUCCESS'
  AND bytes_arquivo IS NOT NULL
  AND ingest_ts >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
GROUP BY
  DATE(ingest_ts)
ORDER BY
  data_verificacao ASC

datasets.name: ing_latencia_evento
queryLines:
SELECT
  CONCAT(
    DATE_FORMAT(from_utc_timestamp(ingest_ts, 'America/Sao_Paulo'), 'dd/MM'),
    ' • ',
    ano
  ) AS evento,
  ROUND(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, last_modified_cvm, ingest_ts) / 60.0, 1) AS latencia_horas
FROM
  proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.controle_ingestao
WHERE
  fonte = 'landing_verificacao'
  AND status = 'SUCCESS'
  AND last_modified_cvm IS NOT NULL
  AND ingest_ts >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
ORDER BY
  ingest_ts ASC

datasets.name: ing_volume_ano
queryLines:
SELECT
  ano,
  ROUND(bytes_arquivo / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 1) AS mb_baixados
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      ano,
      bytes_arquivo,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ano ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC) AS rn
    FROM
      proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.controle_ingestao
    WHERE
      fonte = 'landing_verificacao'
      AND status = 'SUCCESS'
      AND bytes_arquivo IS NOT NULL
  ) sub
WHERE
  rn = 1
ORDER BY
  ano

datasets.name: ing_status_verificacao
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE(ingest_ts) AS data_verificacao,
  status,
  COUNT(*) AS contagem
FROM
  proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.controle_ingestao
WHERE
  fonte = 'landing_verificacao'
  AND ingest_ts >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
GROUP BY
  DATE(ingest_ts),
  status
ORDER BY
  data_verificacao ASC
